Project Fellow-Mathematics
Applications are invited for the post of project fellow in DST sponsored C3ihub, IIT
Kanpur sanctioned project entitled “Design and Analysis of Multivariate Digital
Signature as Post Quantum candidate in NIST”.
Qualification: M.Sc. (Mathematics/Computer Science/IT)/MCA
Fellowship: Rs. 15,000/- per month
Last Date for applying: 31 July 2024
Applications are invited through the following google form link
https://forms.gle/vZNA35SorRQdUAwD8 along with a self attested mark-
sheets/relevant documents.
Email ID: namitatiwari@csjmu.ac.in (Please refer the Email ID for any query)
Hard copy should reach to the Address:
Dr. Namita Tiwari, Incharge, Department of Mathematics, School of Basic Sciences
(Old IBM Building), CSJM University Kanpur-208024 (on or before 05 August 2024, 4
PM).
Dr. Namita Tiwari
Principal Investigator (PI)
Contact: 9935814160
UIET, CSJM University Kanpur
Dr. Anju Dixit
(Deputy Director)
School of Basic Sciences
CSJM University Kanpur
